notes.title: Army of Ruin - Available now!
notes.content:
[h2]Today we're releasing the 1.0 version of Army of Ruin![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43019091/4240571054a715b5afcdc45b6f942c3942b126e8.png[/img]


During the past 8 months we've been in Early Access, we've released [b]over 25 updates[/b] adding lots of new content and features, such as [b]24 playable charactes[/b], [b]over 100 weapons and evolutions[/b], and [b]over 60 different trinkets[/b], many of which were based on the community feedback we've got during the whole process.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1918040/extras/ArmyOfRuin_GameplayGif.gif?t=1666864737[/img]

We believe Army of Ruin has become a great game with lots of contents to unlock and lots of fun to have while doing so, and we hope you think the same way, whether you are a new player or a returning backer!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/6860297/d27102d66ff5f2301f2d0992186536fb5b1ccebb.jpg[/img]

As always, we're eager to hear suggestions and feedback for future content, be it in the Steam forums, in the official Subreddit, or in the official Discord server!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/6860297/e34529c4f4f82c9801c8fd26db52b37d81ab5cfa.jpg[/img]

We're also releasing the official Soundtrack and new bundles to get the game combined with other items (such as our previous games) at a reduced price.

The game will have a 10% discount for the following 10 days, and you can get additional discounts with the themed bundles, such as the Army of Ruin + Soundtrack bundle or Milkstone Complete Collection bundle!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1918040/Army_of_Ruin/

notes.title: Update #45 - Bugfixes and balancing changes
notes.content:
Today's update brings a number of fixes and changes that aim to shake up the game a bit, attempting to make it a bit easier for beginners, while adding some changes that should help the creature against more experienced investigators as well.

These changes aren't as fully tested as usual due to the holiday season, so please report any feedback or issues you might have in the forum.

[b]Gameplay changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Progress bar is no longer shown for caught investigators
[*]Investigators not at full health will have their Speed reduced by 5%, investigators on the brink of death will have their Speed reduced by 10%. This effect is offset by Vitality (higher Vitality means the reduction will be smaller).
[*]Reduced Investigator's Vitality effect on Grab duration (so values won't be as extreme when grabbing investigators with very high/low Vitality).
[*]Changed Olkoth's Stigma perk to affect Endurance instead of Speed.
[*]Investigators' Compass will now point to the clue from a closer distance (so it's a bit easier to find nearby clues).
[*]Creature's speed is increased by 10% when stunned.
[*]Investigators' base endurance is increased by 20% (so they can sprint for longer).
[*]Creature's Light resistance increases a bit slower when being exposed to light (~20% slower).
[*]Reduced distance at which creature is banished when solving a clue from 15 to 10 meters.
[*]Reduced Split penalty to Exploration and Bravery by ~20%
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Ranked game count wasn't properly saved.
[*]Should have reduced stuttering during gameplay a bit.
[*]Fixed a number of collision issues reported on the Discord channel.
[*]Implemented automatic lobby countdown on Competitive (so the game will start even if the host is AFK).
[/list]

notes.title: Update #20 - The Answer Lies Within
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26539617/6881bc6d189ff0d115d119106065db33042d7aaa.png[/img]

In this update, the investigators will need to overcome several trials to uncover the clues that will aid them against the unknown evil!

In addition to finding old tapes, they'll have to decode arcane tomes forgotten through the ages, seal ancient rifts created in other worlds and defuse complex mechanisms that weren't designed to be opened.

This update also includes a big amount of improvements on visuals and gameplay, such as seeing the equipped items of other players or more disturbing scare/craziness effects.

[b]New features:[/b]
[list]
[*]3 New types of goals can be spawned in Landmarks other than tapes: Grimoires, Arcane Chests and Prisms. They are a bit more complex to accomplish, so only 2 of these are spawned per game.
[*]When a public game is full, an automatic 60 seconds countdown starts. The game will start even if not everyone has chosen their team/character/equipment at that point. [b]This hasn't been thoroughly tested so please report any issues.[/b]
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*]New visual effect on scarejumps/monster screams/craziness
[*]The equipped item is shown in the investigator's back
[*]The Waiting for players/Waiting for host/countdown title in the lobby now blinks when something important is being shown.
[*]Brought back the old Insanity animation.
[*]Increased visibility of other people's flashlights.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]In 1vs1, the investigator is automatically freed when caught by the creature (unless there are no lives left).
[*]Reduced minimum compass distance (so it only shows a circle if you're closer), to compensate for the difficulty of the new goals.
[*]Iker: Increased Optimist effect from 15% to 20%, reduced Clumsy effect from 20% to 15%.
[*]Anna: Athlete now also makes her less noisy when running, reduced Suspicious effect from 8% to 5%.
[*]Reduced number of Medkits spawned from 3-4 to 2.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed some sound issues.
[*]Fixed Coop games being shown as "Waiting for Creature" in the main menu and the Quick Play section.
[*]Fixed character models always floating 5cm above ground.
[*]Fixed customize input button not showing the proper instructions for gamepads.
[*]Removed left hand reaching interactable objects for other players (this was not intended to be shown).
[*]Fixed some buildings in the Abbey disappearing under some circumstances.
[/list]

notes.title: Update #17 - Hotfix update
notes.content:
Hello!

We've decided to release a quick update after seeing a huge winrate for the creatures after the last update. We knew creatures would have it a bit easier, but didn't expect a 90% winrate!

This update tones down some of the most powerful idols, and changes a bit the way shared power cooldowns work, among other things.

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an area being unreachable by the creature but not by survivors in the Bunker.
[*]Fixed Vincent model not looking up/down
[*]Fixed game entering an unresponsive state when failing to create a custom match.
[*]Fixed players being able to exit the area by climbing some rocks in the Abbey.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Shared creature power cooldown time now depends on the power used: 5 seconds for Sprint, 10 seconds for powers not directly affecting investigators (Scarecrow, EMP, Decoy...), 15 seconds for the rest.
[*]Anna: Increased Endurance, reduced battery usage.
[*]Pustules: Reduced power increase from 5% to 4% per totem.
[*]Blisters: Reduced impact to exploration from 5% to 3% per totem.
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added an onscreen message when the game fails to start because of DLL issues (so there shouldn't be more "Empty black screen" errors).
[/list]

notes.title: Update #9 - Run for your life! (Plus Rusalka teaser)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26539617/37aa1d03112738a612f8ef2c93137bd1e584e082.jpg[/img]

This update features a series of changes aiming for a quicker, more satisfying game experience, probably increasing the chances of the investigator team. Many of them are centered on walking/running speed.

These may be a bit extreme so feel free to comment your impressions on the forums!

[b]Gameplay changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Abbey: Added more totem spawns
[*]Hospital: Fixed some issues with monster teleport positions.
[*]Creature: Reduced shared power cooldown from 15 to 10 seconds.
[*]Creature: Can't cast powers while invisible
[*]Creature: Sprint power disables (silently) if you get near the investigators.
[*]Creature: Slightly increased base speed (around 3%)
[*]Creature: Slightly increased Speed stat effectiveness
[*]Creature: Decreased speed while stunned by light by 5%
[*]Creature: Decreased maximum endurance (time before fleeing) from 15 seconds to 12.
[*]Creature compass: Now it will take Stealth into consideration when determining the closest investigator.
[*]Increased Subject 23 Power stat.
[*]Investigators: Base endurance value reduced from 6 seconds to 5.
[*]Investigators: Increased Endurance stat effectiveness.
[*]Investigators: Increased Speed stat effectiveness (still a bit lower than it was pre-patch)
[*]Investigators: Increased base speed by 5%, and sprint speed by 3%
[*]Increased Phil's Flashlight stat.
[*]Decreased Hannah's Stealth stat.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed walking 20% slower when the flashlight is On, now investigators will walk 20% slower with the flashlight Off, as originally intended.
[/list]

We're also showing a Teaser image of Rusalka, the new creature we'll be adding soon (probably by next week). Rusalka is a fast tracker, but really weak to light, so it will need to make good use of its new powers to overcome that weakness, set traps and cause chaos to disband the group and hunt stranded investigators. We're still tuning some values around it, but we think the general feeling and gameplay is fun and different from the original.

notes.title: Update #5 - Introducing investigator traits!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26539617/c6409d6dda58b2d979b951f6e8c4d2e7acbc906f.png[/img]

Today's update introduces a new feature: Investigator traits.

These traits are minor passive skills that make each character behave differently on certain situations. For example, Iker has Optimist, that allows him to recover some sanity when picking up a tape, and Clumsy, that increases the interaction time when picking up batteries or disabling Idols.

Each investigator has one positive and one negative trait, there's no one in his sane mind in this game!

Among other notable changes are the connection quality indicator in the lobby, the addition of the French community translation and a new look for the tapes.

[b]New features:[/b]
[list]
[*]First version of Investigator traits
[*]New tape model, now it has a speaker and some glowing items on it.
[*]Added French community translation
[*]Added a connection quality icon for each player on the lobby.
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Connection error messages should be a bit more useful.
[*]On Quick Join, the game looks for sessions in a closer range than before, and then switches to broader ranges if no games are found. Should help in getting better connections for crowded areas, and finding people on less crowded ones.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Increased investigator skill cooldown by approximately 10%.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed Compass icon not refreshing properly when the monster is forced to teleported away (the compass could be used but the UI didn't reflect it properly).
[*]Now players can't join a game with a different network protocol version via invite.
[/list]

Trait values and effects are subject to change depending on player feedback and gameplay statistics.

On next content update, we're aiming to add a new game location, the Abbey, so stay tuned for more!

notes.title: Update #1 - Hotfix, and some details
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26539617/9e5cd05fca3ee41b711247106704e7e30fc3c913.png[/img]

Hi, hope you could get some sleep past night! Or did you have some nightmares? :)

Today we're releasing the first update for the game. This update focuses on fixing the most important issues found so far: Investigators not being able to coordinate properly, and difficulty of locating a nearby tape.

Some of these fixes are temporary until we can get a better solution, but they should be enough to improve overall experience.

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved tape visibility, so it's easier to locate once you're near it if you're not playing with headphones.
[*]Ghost' shouts are shown with a different color.
[*]You can see a player's nick over his head when you're close.
[*]A player using quick chat is highlighted when you're close (only investigators).
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed some missing walls in the Hospital level.
[*](Hopefully) Fixed being unable to connect to some games.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Investigator skill cooldown reduced for large parties (~20% shorter cooldowns)
[*]Changed the "I'm lost!" quick chat text to "There's a tape nearby!"
[*]Added a time penalty when abusing the Shout skill.
[*]Ghosts can see players from further distance, and they can also be seen from further when they shout.
[*]When a monster catches an investigator while using the blackout power, all flashlights are fixed right away. (To avoid weird situations where people are just left waiting for the flashlight to recover to save a nearby partner).
[/list]

Our next step will be to monitor game statistics during the weekend, checking victory rates for each side and game lenghts. Our target is between 66% and 80% win rate for the creature, and we're currently at 70%, so for now it's all coming up nicely :)

For next week, we'll try to focus work on finding/fixing most important causes for players not enjoying the game, so if that's your case and you're not having fun, please pass by the forums and share your impressions. One of the things we've noticed and will try to fix is that some games can get too long (20+ minutes) because there's currently no time limit and games can drag out too much if neither team advances on their goals.

(By the way, average game length is ~10 minutes for matches where the creature wins, and ~13 minutes for matches where investigators win).

Have fun!
